name: Training the Beast
label: Quest
description: Training the Beast: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet.
Go with the winds, young adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A fledgling adventurer, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Remember, friend, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
